amendment.description: An amendment numbered 8 printed in Part A of House Report 119-749 to prohibit funds appropriated by the Act from being used for Israel, and accordingly reduces the Foreign Military Financing Program account by $3,300,000,000.

vote.text: On agreeing to the Massie amendment (A005) Failed by recorded vote: 104 - 314, 10 Present (Roll no. 243).
